name: URI PALS
aka: URI PALS (Urban Resource Institute, People and Animals Living Safely)
region_note: IF PEOPLE ARE AT RISK TOO
notes:
(646) 588-0030 - urinyc.org/uripals - for a survivor who needs to leave but cannot abandon a pet. A New York City shelter programme that houses survivors together with their pets: dogs, cats and small animals.

the largest DV shelter provider in the U.S.; NYC co-living shelters let survivors bring pets, with private pet-friendly areas. Free. urinyc.org (ask about PALS); NYC DV Hotline (24/7): (800) 621-HOPE / (800) 621-4673.
